description:
Recover interrupted work after compaction, resume or lost context. Returns Markdown checkpoints, decisions, gotchas, open loops and recent events. Unlike engram_start, this restores the prior journal when available; unlike engram_recall or engram_smarter, it recovers session history rather than only searching durable knowledge.

session_id selects an accessible workspace session. Closed or teammate journals are read-only history, never reopened. Automatic recovery requires one active journal for this member, repo/project and authenticated OAuth connection or supplied agent_tool within the recovery window. Multiple matches return 409: list sessions and choose an id. since filters events after selection. If none matches, loads durable task memory and opens a journal. Repeating active recovery adds events; it does not erase history. Consumes workspace daily call quota. OAuth: memory:read and session:write.

agent_tool.description: Calling client name for attribution, e.g. codex, claude-code, cursor, or gemini. Omit if unknown.

depth.description: Default standard: up to 30 events/4 summaries; brief uses 12/2, full 60/8. This controls journal detail, not retrieval depth.

project.description: Product/project name for session context. Start/setup use it as the repository hint when repo is omitted.

reason.description: Recovery trigger, e.g. context compaction or resumed after interruption; recorded in the journal.

repo.description: Repository slug, e.g. engram or billing-api, within the authenticated workspace. This is a memory filter, not a filesystem path or workspace selector.

session_id.description: Exact journal id from start/rehydrate/list_sessions. Disambiguates parallel work; writing requires your active session. Rehydrate may read shared or closed history.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 lower bound for journal events, e.g. 2026-10-16T10:00:00Z; omit for normal recent-session recovery.

task.description: Concrete current goal or decision, e.g. diagnose checkout retries; used to focus context and session recovery.

name: engram_rehydrate

format.description: Payload encoding: Markdown context/checkpoint, serialized JSON data, or plain confirmation text.

text.description: The same bounded payload as content[0].text; interpret it using format. JSON text contains the endpoint-specific fields described by this tool.

truncated.description: True when the payload exceeded 120,000 characters and was cut with a notice. Narrow the request; truncated JSON is not parseable.

title: Rehydrate Context
